notes: §1985:XIV.3.2.2 prints DISABLE {INPUT [TERMINAL] | I-O TERMINAL | OUTPUT} cd-name-1 [WITH KEY {identifier-1 | literal-1}]; disableStatement with communicationPath parses exactly those three arms and communicationKeyPhrase the optional WITH and required KEY with one sending operand, BindDisable/BindPath bind it, and the edition pass gates the statement (CommunicationFacilityRemoved2014) and the KEY phrase (CommunicationKeyPhraseRemoved2002) only from 2002, so 85 reaches the whole format. Witness: DISABLE OUTPUT TERMINAL refused COBOL0901 at line 10. Probes at --std 85 (b): no path word, I-O without TERMINAL, OUTPUT TERMINAL, INPUT TERMINAL TERMINAL, INPUT OUTPUT, a bare TERMINAL, zero operands, two cd-names, WITH KEY with no operand, KEY written twice, WITH without KEY are each refused (COBOL0307/5506/0001/0901/2269); every legal arm (INPUT, INPUT TERMINAL, I-O TERMINAL, OUTPUT; KEY with and without WITH; literal, identifier, ref-mod, ALL literal, SPACES, alphanumeric function) translates and runs (statuses 21/21/30 with no MCS defined, class e). (c) at 85 the 2002+ operand forms N"AB", X"41", "A" & "B" and FUNCTION CONCAT are refused COBOL0900/1502; the KEY phrase is COBOL0902 from 2002 and the statement COBOL0902 at 2014/2023. (d) a numeric, numeric-edited, alphabetic, 18-digit or negative KEY operand is COBOL6171 (SR4).

next.reason: 1985: "DISABLE { INPUT [ TERMINAL ] | I-O TERMINAL | OUTPUT } cd-name-1 [ WITH KEY { identifier-1 | literal-1 } ]"; 2023: "no DISABLE statement or communication module among the candidates; they cover CANCEL, OPEN, USE and screen clauses only". DISABLE is a communication-module statement. No 2023 candidate covers it or cd-names, so the feature is shown absent from 2023.
